eyebrow: Data Modeling & Data Warehousing · Chapter 4, Lesson 19
subtitle: One extra column, one prior value

caption: The row keeps one prior value alongside the current one — no new row.

code:
ALTER TABLE DimSalesperson
  ADD PreviousSalesRegionKey     INT  NULL,
      PreviousSalesRegionEndDate DATE NULL;

UPDATE DimSalesperson
SET    PreviousSalesRegionKey     = SalesRegionKey,
       PreviousSalesRegionEndDate = '2024-05-23',
       SalesRegionKey             = 5
WHERE  SalespersonKey = 296;
caption: The current value is captured into a Previous* column before it's overwritten.
